label: Location
reveals: The approximate city and region your internet connection appears to be in, looked up from your IP address by our own server.

label: Device Type
reveals: Whether you are on a desktop, mobile or tablet, and which operating system, as your browser announces it.

label: Browser
reveals: Which browser and which major version you are using.

label: Internet Provider
reveals: The name of the company that provides your internet connection, looked up from your IP address by our own server.

label: Time Pattern
reveals: The local day and time on your device at the moment the scan ran.

label: Screen Resolution
reveals: The width and height of your screen in pixels.

label: Privacy Settings
reveals: Whether your browser is set to send the Do Not Track request.

label: Connection Type
reveals: The kind of connection your browser says it is on (fast mobile, Wi-Fi and so on).

label: How You Found Us
reveals: Which kind of site sent you here (search engine, social network, a link, or directly).

label: Device Status
reveals: Your battery percentage and whether it is charging, where the browser allows it.

label: Primary Language
reveals: The main language your browser is set to.

label: Language Fallbacks
reveals: The extra languages your browser lists after the main one.

label: Locale Mismatch
reveals: Whether your language setting looks out of step with the timezone you are in.

label: Estimated Profile
reveals: A rough age-band guess that the site makes from your operating system, browser and the time of day.

label: User Profile
reveals: A one-word lifestyle label (local, traveler, expatriate, multilingual) worked out from your language settings.

label: Orientation
reveals: Whether your screen is held upright or sideways.

label: Rotation
reveals: The angle your screen is rotated to, in degrees.

label: Tilt Forward/Back
reveals: How far your device is tilted forward or back, if it has a motion sensor and has permission.

label: Tilt Left/Right
reveals: How far your device is tilted left or right, if it has a motion sensor and has permission.

label: Motion Sensors
reveals: Whether your device has a motion sensor (gyroscope) a site could read.

label: Canvas Fingerprint
reveals: A short code produced by asking your browser to draw a hidden image; different devices draw it slightly differently.

label: WebGL Signature
reveals: The graphics card and driver name your browser reports.

label: Audio Signature
reveals: A short code produced by processing a silent sound in your browser; devices differ slightly.

label: Installed Fonts
reveals: How many fonts from a test list are installed on your device.

label: Extensions
reveals: Whether an ad blocker or browser plug-ins could be detected.

label: Fingerprint Protection
reveals: Whether your browser has a known fingerprint shield (Tor, Brave Shields, Firefox protection or a blocking extension).

label: WebRTC Leak
reveals: Whether your browser reveals your real internet address to a website even when you use a VPN.

label: CPU Cores
reveals: How many processor cores, and how much memory where reported, your device says it has.

label: Display Profile
reveals: Your screen size, colour depth and pixel density together.

label: Timezone/Locale
reveals: Your timezone and the regional format your browser uses for dates and numbers.

label: Battery Status
reveals: The battery level and charging state, or a note that the browser hides it.

label: Connected Devices
reveals: How many cameras, microphones and speakers your browser can see, without turning them on.

label: Cookies
reveals: How many cookies myprivacytool.io has stored in your browser, and how many look like trackers.

label: Local Storage
reveals: How many items this site has saved in your browser's local storage, and how big.

label: Session Storage
reveals: How many items this site holds in session storage for this tab, and how big.

label: IndexedDB
reveals: How many databases this site has created in your browser.

label: Cache & SW
reveals: Whether this site has a background service worker or saved offline files in your browser.

label: Google Account
reveals: Whether Google sign-in cookies are visible to this page.

label: Meta Services
reveals: Whether Facebook or Instagram sign-in cookies are visible to this page.

label: Microsoft Account
reveals: Whether Microsoft sign-in cookies are visible to this page.

label: Social Platforms
reveals: Whether sign-in cookies for LinkedIn, TikTok, Reddit and other social platforms are visible to this page.

label: Cross-Site Identity
reveals: Whether tracking cookies from ad networks and single sign-on are visible to this page.

label: DNS Leak
reveals: A test labelled 'DNS leak' that is really a second WebRTC probe for your network addresses.

label: Connection Security
reveals: Whether you reached this site over an encrypted connection.

label: Mixed Content
reveals: Whether this page loaded any resources over an unencrypted connection.

label: Security Headers
reveals: A score for how many protective web headers this site appears to send.

label: Browser Status
reveals: Whether your browser version is older than a cut-off the code keeps in a list.

label: Encryption
reveals: Which version of encryption your connection is likely using.

label: Mouse Tracking
reveals: How many mouse movements the site recorded while you used this page.

label: Keystroke Dynamics
reveals: How many keystrokes were timed (not what you typed) while you were on this page.

label: Click Patterns
reveals: How many clicks the site recorded and how fast you click.

label: Scroll Behavior
reveals: How far down the page you scrolled and how you scrolled.

label: Session Duration
reveals: How long you have been on this page, how long active, idle, and how many times you switched tabs.

label: Engagement Map
reveals: A map of where on the page you moved and clicked the most (hotspots).

label: Postal area
reveals: Postcode and map point of the IP address, sharper than city

label: IP timezone vs device clock
reveals: Timezone of the IP against the device timezone; a gap suggests VPN, travel or proxy

label: Network distance
reveals: Round-trip time to our edge and which data centre answered; long times hint at a tunnel

label: Network owner type
reveals: Owner of the IP block: home broadband, mobile, company, cloud host

reveals: Hash of the ciphers and extensions the browser offers; identifies browser build and bots

label: HTTP version
reveals: HTTP/1.1, 2 or 3; older stacks and some privacy tools differ

label: SMS Delivery Timestamp
reveals: Timestamp when SMS was delivered to recipient device. Extractable via Twilio API.

label: HTTP Referrer URL
reveals: The full URL of the webpage the user visited immediately before arriving at our site. Reveals user intent and previous browsing context.

label: UTM Campaign Parameters
reveals: URL query strings (utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign) used to track marketing effectiveness. Can link anonymous sessions to specific user demographics or sensitive interests.

label: First-Party Analytics Cookie ID
reveals: Persistent identifier (e.g., _ga, _fbp) assigned by analytics tools (Google Analytics, Meta Pixel) to track user behavior across multiple sessions and pages.

label: Document Metadata (Author/IP/GPS)
reveals: Hidden data embedded in uploaded files (PDF, Office, Images) revealing real names, internal network IPs, or precise location.

label: Historical Web Archive Snapshots
reveals: Cached or archived versions of deleted social media posts, forum comments, or personal websites stored by services like the Wayback Machine.

label: Cross-Platform Username Correlation
reveals: The ability of OSINT tools to link a single username across multiple platforms, connecting professional identity to anonymous or sensitive forum activity.

label: Public IoT / Network Device Exposure
reveals: Discovery of user's publicly accessible internet-connected devices (webcams, routers, smart home) via search engines like Shodan.

label: Telegram Forwarding Metadata (Original Author/Channel)
reveals: Metadata attached to forwarded messages that reveals the original source channel or user, creating visible network links.

label: Telegram Channel Clone / Impersonation Risk
reveals: The risk of malicious actors creating duplicate channels with similar usernames/titles to copy content or impersonate a brand/individual for scams.

label: Telegram Public Subscriber & Growth Metrics
reveals: Publicly visible channel statistics (subscriber count, growth rate) that are often artificially inflated by clone networks to build false credibility.

label: Messaging App Profile Leakage (WhatsApp/Viber)
reveals: Profile picture, 'About' bio, and 'Last Seen' status visible to anyone who saves your phone number to their contacts, even without mutual interaction.

label: Email Address Permutation Patterns
reveals: Automated guessing and validation of corporate or personal email formats (e.g., first.last@domain.com) to map organizational staff or individual aliases.

label: Image EXIF Metadata (GPS/Camera)
reveals: Hidden data embedded in image files revealing precise GPS coordinates, camera model, and device serial numbers at the time of capture.

label: Data Broker Sister-Domain Repopulation
reveals: The practice of data brokers repopulating opted-out personal records on newly registered 'sister' domains to circumvent deletion requests.

label: Payment Platform Name Search Leakage (e.g., PayPal)
reveals: The ability to reveal a user's full legal name and current town of residence by typing partial name characters into a payment platform's peer-to-peer search interface.
register_label: Payment Platform Name Search Leakage (e.g., PayPal)

label: SS7/Diameter Real-Time Location Leakage (Cell ID)
reveals: The exposure of a user's precise real-time cell tower location (Cell ID) and regional routing data (MSC/VLR) via unauthenticated telecom signaling protocols (SS7/Diameter).

label: IMSI (International Mobile Subscriber Identity) Exposure
reveals: The permanent, unique SIM card identifier that can be tracked across global networks, exploited for SS7 location tracking, or harvested by local IMSI catchers.

label: IMSI Catcher / False Base Station Interception
reveals: The vulnerability to local cell tower spoofing (Stingrays) that forces a device to connect to a malicious base station, enabling precise location tracking and traffic interception.
register_label: IMSI Catcher / False Base Station Interception

label: LinkedIn Custom URL Cross-Platform Leakage
reveals: The use of a custom LinkedIn profile URL that acts as a persistent username, enabling attackers to easily find the same username reused across other personal or anonymous platforms.

label: LinkedIn Connection & Endorsement Network Mapping
reveals: The exposure of a user's professional network, skills, and endorsements, which can be used to triangulate their real-world location, field of work, security clearances, and past associates.

label: LinkedIn Document & Media Upload Leakage
reveals: The exposure of hidden metadata, unredacted contact information, or revealing filenames within PDFs, images, or documents uploaded to a professional profile.

label: User Agent & Device Fingerprinting Leakage
reveals: The exposure of device make, model, OS, browser version, and screen dimensions via HTTP User-Agent strings, enabling cross-site tracking and unique device fingerprinting.

label: RTB (Real-Time Bidding) Device Data Broadcast
reveals: The automatic broadcasting of device properties, carrier, IP, and location data to hundreds of unknown third-party advertisers during programmatic ad auctions.

label: Mobile Sensor Context Leakage (Accelerometer/Compass)
reveals: The exploitation of device motion and orientation sensors by web apps to infer the user's physical context, such as whether they are stationary, moving, or lying down.

label: Public DNS Zone Transfer Exposure
reveals: Misconfigured DNS servers allowing unauthorized public queries to dump the entire list of internal subdomains and network topology.

label: Domain Registration Contact Info Exposure (WHOIS)
reveals: Publicly accessible domain registration records revealing the registrant's real name, physical address, phone number, and email address.

label: HTML Source Code Metadata Leakage
reveals: Hidden comments, internal IP addresses, or developer names left in the HTML source code of public-facing websites.

label: Contact Intelligence & Identity Resolution Profiling
reveals: The algorithmic aggregation of online and offline data points from multiple sources to create a single, comprehensive identity profile, bypassing individual platform privacy controls.

label: Lead Scoring & Behavioral Data Enrichment
reveals: The assignment of predictive scores to individuals based on linked professional, social, and demographic data, increasing their visibility to targeted marketing and social engineering.

label: Unsanitized Threat Indicator Sharing
reveals: The risk of inadvertently leaking PII, internal IPs, or network topology when sharing raw logs, PCAPs, or email samples with third parties, forums, or support teams.

label: Lack of Data Handling Designations (e.g., TLP)
reveals: The risk of uncontrolled dissemination of sensitive personal incident reports due to the absence of standardized handling labels like the Traffic Light Protocol (TLP).
register_label: Lack of Data Handling Designations (e.g., TLP)

label: Anonymized Data Re-identification Risk
reveals: The risk of being uniquely identified from supposedly anonymized datasets by cross-referencing 15+ public demographic or behavioral parameters (e.g., zip code, gender, marital status).

label: Cryptocurrency Wallet & Transaction Linkage
reveals: The permanent, public linking of pseudonymous blockchain wallet addresses to real-world identities via repeated transaction patterns, IP leaks, or website appearances.

label: Machine & Workload Identity Leakage
reveals: The exposure of software, container, API, or IoT device credentials that can be exploited to pivot and compromise human accounts or underlying infrastructure.

label: Historical Web Archive & Cache Leakage
reveals: The indefinite preservation of deleted, outdated, or scrubbed personal information (old emails, phone numbers, posts) in services like the Wayback Machine or search engine caches.

label: Audit Log Visibility Exposure
reveals: Restrict audit log read permission to admins only; remove audit.read scope from bots; Discord auto-purges after 90 days

label: Bot Token Leakage in Commands
reveals: Rotate token immediately in Discord Developer Portal; revoke old token (instant); audit bot activity logs; scan GitHub for leaks (GitGuardian, TruffleHog)

label: OAuth Scope Over-Permission
reveals: Revoke OAuth app in Discord settings (Applications → Authorized Apps); revocation is immediate. All-or-nothing authorization (cannot grant scopes selectively).

label: Message History & Deletion Lag
reveals: Individual message deletion (removes from Discord UI only); third-party archives are not affected. User can request admin disable archiving bots (not enforceable).

label: Server Invite Tracking & Profiling
reveals: User cannot prevent Discord invites from being tracked externally. User cannot opt out of invite analytics. User can leave server (stops contributing to metrics).

label: Bulk Member Enumeration & Export
reveals: Admin can restrict export permission to trusted users only. No way to prevent export entirely. Exported files should be encrypted and access-controlled. No API to purge from external storage. Users cannot opt out.

label: IP Address Exposure via P2P Features
register_label: IP Address Exposure via P2P Features

label: LinkedIn Connection Graph Exposure
reveals: Restrict public profile, disable connection visibility, archive old jobs. Source: OSINT Insights (MPC-9248), Gap 2. Spec code HEX-LIN-002.

label: Port & Protocol Enumeration (Unexpected Service Migration)
reveals: Migrate services to standard ports, decommission abandoned services, implement port suppression. Source: OSINT Insights (MPC-9248), Gap 5. Spec code HEX-SHO-006.
register_label: HEX-SHO-006 - Port & Protocol Enumeration (Unexpected Service Migration)

label: Default Credential & Firmware Exposure (Banner Analysis)
register_label: HEX-SHO-007 - Default Credential & Firmware Exposure (Banner Analysis)

label: Attacker's-Eye Audit (Proactive Footprinting Checklist)
reveals: Perform self-reconnaissance (Google dorking, DNS queries, WHOIS lookups), remove publicly findable data. Source: OSINT Insights (MPC-9248), Gap 6. Spec code HEX-AUD-001.

label: Threat Intelligence & PII Redaction (Shareable Incident Reports)
reveals: Auto-apply TLP (e.g. TLP:AMBER) and PII redaction checklists before sharing any MPT incident reports. Source: OSINT Insights (MPC-9248), Gap 7. Spec code HEX-INF-001. Risk Score left empty (source says Low-Medium). Related to HEX-390 (data handling designations / TLP).
register_label: HEX-INF-001 - Threat Intelligence & PII Redaction (Shareable Incident Reports)

label: Personal Risk Register & Tolerance Framework
reveals: Build UI for users to set risk tolerance, auto-prioritize hexagon remediations, track residual risk. Source: OSINT Insights (MPC-9248), Gap 8. Spec code HEX-RRM-001. Risk Score left empty (source says N/A, an enabler rather than an exposure).
register_label: HEX-RRM-001 - Personal Risk Register & Tolerance Framework

label: Breach Data Classes Exposed
reveals: Which kinds of data leaked with the address in each known breach (passwords, phone numbers, dates of birth). Tool: HaveIBeenPwned. Proposed confidence 92/100. Needs the person's consent (MPC-11307).

label: Leaked Credentials and Password Hashes
reveals: Whether a password or password hash tied to the address sits in leaked databases. Tool: Dehashed. Proposed confidence 70/100. Never store or show the password or hash; keep only yes/no, count and source name. Needs consent (MPC-11307).

label: Breach-Linked Identity Details
reveals: Name, phone, address, IP or username that leaked in the same record as the email. Tool: Dehashed. Proposed confidence 62/100. Needs consent (MPC-11307).

label: Username Reuse Across Platforms
reveals: The same username registered on many sites, linking separate accounts into one profile. Tools: Sherlock, WhatsMyName. Proposed confidence 55/100 for a single-tool hit. Needs consent (MPC-11307).

label: Google Account Footprint
reveals: Whether the address is a Google account and what is public on it: account ID, name, photo, Maps reviews and photos, YouTube channel, calendar. Tool: GHunt (needs a signed-in Google session on our side). Proposed confidence 78/100. Needs consent (MPC-11307).

label: Email Registration Footprint
reveals: The services where this address already has an account (around 120 sites checked). Tool: Holehe. Proposed confidence 66/100. Raise risk to High if a dating, adult, health or finance site is found. Needs consent (MPC-11307).
